audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 read Vayne and Levels 4-5 read Skill in both layers, against the packet chart (Skill / Zaahen) and against the mirror audit, which already aligned those two rows from Vayne's side.
audit.why: The content whys for those rows already say 'Level 2 stays neutral' and 'At 4-5 you claw ahead' — the tokens contradicted their own text, and the mirror would overwrite them anyway.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side -> Skill and win[3]/phases[3].side -> Zaahen, proposed as one atomic group, with phases[3].rating raised to 6/10 to match a Zaahen-sided row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike credited Zaahen's R with 'lockdown', and described Final Hour as 'stealth-plus-invisibility on Tumble'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Zaahen's R is rise, stab, heal for a portion of the damage — no CC at all; his displacement lives on the Q recast and W. Final Hour grants invisibility during Tumble, bonus AD, a reduced Tumble cooldown and more Night Hunter move speed.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten around the R heal, Final Hour's 100s cooldown and Condemn's 20s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn was called a wall-stun with no cooldown or range; Tumble's auto-attack reset was never mentioned as the trade tell; Zaahen's 850-range W pull as the gap-closer against a kiting marksman was absent.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s at 550 range and only stuns if terrain catches you — fighting in open lane removes the stun entirely. Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s and resets her attack, so the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue (flagged in missingInteractions as autoreset-burst-tell). Both sides carry displacement, and W's 850 range beats her 550.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the real numbers, the reset tell and the pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried the placeholder 'Your committal tool' and no numbers.
audit.why: Condemn's 20s at rank 1 is the window the whole lane hangs on.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Condemn, Tumble and the W pull.

edits.before: Your one clear window is level 6 — R Final Retribution's lockdown and heal lets you close the gap and burst her before Final Hour (her R) stealth-plus-invisibility on Tumble lets her reposition; force the all-in the instant her E Condemn is on cooldown.
edits.after: Your one clear window is level 6 — your R heals off the damage it deals, so close and burst her down before Final Hour (100s at rank 1) turns every Tumble invisible; force the all-in the instant Condemn is spent, because it is 20s at rank 1 and it is her only disengage.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Wall-stun on a 20s cooldown at rank 1. Step in the moment it is spent.

edits.before: Probe Vayne's pattern early, then commit your full combo only on his key cooldown — bank knowledge before blood.
edits.after: Tumble is an auto reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue; answer it with your 850-range W pull.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Fight with open lane behind you — Condemn only stuns if terrain catches you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Every third hit is max-health true damage — armour will not save you.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Her first-item timing is the lane's clock — every wave you concede buys the spike that flips it.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn: 20/18/16/14/12s, 550 range — a stun only into terrain. Step in the moment it is spent. - Tumble: 6s at rank 1, an auto reset; the wind-up is the tell. - Your W: an 850-range pull. - Your R: kill windows only.

notes: Zaahen's R was described as lockdown in spikes[1].text; the kit gives it no CC, only damage and a heal. Corrected. Zaahen's own ability names in prose ('Darkin Glaive', 'Golden Onslaught', 'Final Retribution') are unverifiable from the kit file — the missing-interactions headlines for this exact pairing do confirm 'The Darkin Glaive (Q)' and 'Dreaded Return (W)', but nothing confirms the E or R names, so I left them where they already stood.
